en.headline: Authorities say missing lift fire door frames confined to Taizoom
en.dek: Inspections found no similar omissions among other contractors after 338 buildings serviced by Taizoom Elevator were confirmed to lack the components.
body: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said on Thursday that inspections had found no missing fire-resistant door frame components in lifts maintained by contractors other than Taizoom Elevator.

Citywide checks of lifts serviced by Taizoom began on 16 October after the components were found absent from 48 newly installed lifts at two public housing estates. The department later confirmed that 338 buildings under Taizoom’s service lacked the parts designed to help prevent flames and smoke from entering the lift shaft in a fire.

The department had expanded the inspection scope to cover lifts handled by other registered contractors to determine whether the problem was more widespread. Thursday’s update indicated the omissions appeared confined to Taizoom.

The missing components constitute non-compliance, though the department has previously said the lifts can continue to operate safely. Taizoom has been instructed to install the outstanding parts at its own expense. Police are investigating suspected deception and false statements.

zh.headline: 機電署指升降機缺失防火門框僅限臺日電梯
zh.dek: 當局表示，除臺日電梯外，其他承辦商維修的升降機未發現同類缺失防火門框組件的情況。
body: 機電工程署周四表示，檢查發現除臺日電梯外，其他承辦商所維修的升降機並無缺失防火門框組件。
機電署自10月16日起對臺日電梯負責的升降機展開全城檢查，此前兩個公共屋邨共48部新安裝升降機被發現缺少相關組件。署方其後確認，由臺日電梯負責的338幢大廈同樣缺少這些用以在火警時阻隔火焰及煙霧進入升降機槽的部件。
署方早前已擴大檢查範圍，涵蓋其他註冊承辦商負責的升降機，以確定問題是否更廣泛。周四的更新顯示，缺失情況似乎僅限於臺日電梯。
缺失組件構成違規，惟署方早前指出升降機仍可安全運作。臺日電梯已被指示自行負責安裝缺失部件。警方正調查涉嫌欺詐及作出虛假陳述。
